recommendation: Keep the source fix. It addresses the seed issue's remaining category terminology gaps without changing unrelated Device behavior. FHIR-20574 should be handled separately if its broader search-parameter or DeviceDefinition-category aspects still need review.
issue_request: FHIR-32080 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Device change request for machine-understandable high-level Device categorization. The decision called for Device type/category example tables and links to the FHIR-20574 scope categories; the Jira comment listed active, communicating, durable medical equipment, home use, implantable, InVitro diagnostics, patient use, personal health, point-of-care, single use, re-usable, and software.
initial_application: The current source already had Device.category as a 0..* CodeableConcept bound to ValueSet/device-category. The Device category terminology appears to have been added in git commit 14e5c20f1f34a491dd0b8af3b9f1bf8bc1082b2c, but that commit left patient-use commented out, omitted personal-health, used the incorrect display Maintenance for home-use, and copied an association-state description into ValueSet/device-category.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini, and the edited terminology files live under the active source/device folder and are bound by Device.category. The FHIR-20574 scope/boundary decision and Device Scope-Boundary-Relationships Confluence page provide the approved category vocabulary and detailed patient-use and personal health descriptions. The later Published FHIR-35984 decision preserved current Device category example wording with personal health and software. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/device/codesystem-device-category.xml to correct home-use to Home Use, align its definition with the approved scope wording, and add patient-use and personal-health concepts. Updated source/device/valueset-device-category.xml so the value set description identifies Device category rather than association state.
source_changes: source/device/codesystem-device-category.xml: corrected the home-use display and definition and added patient-use and personal-health concepts.
source/device/valueset-device-category.xml: corrected the value set description from association state to Device category.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-32080 explicitly referenced the FHIR-20574 Device scope/boundary categories, but this reconciliation did not decide FHIR-20574's broader search-parameter and DeviceDefinition-category scope.
A later Published Device decision kept the high-level category examples sentence, including personal health and software, supporting the category terminology correction.
